goal: Install bash and fish completion scripts automatically alongside their binaries during CMake installation
Saves packagers and users from manually copying completion scripts into system directories
agreement: Strong support with multiple substantive test ACKs and no open objections
Tested prefix install, DESTDIR staging, and completion toggles on Debian (151henry151)
Tested installation and completion functionality on Ubuntu and Arch Linux (BrandonOdiwuor, caesrcd)
Concept approval without stated reasons (hebasto, w0xlt)
Resolved suggestion to add per-shell installation toggles by splitting CMake options (luke-jr)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it adds convenience for packagers and users by installing shell completions via CMake
Does not affect core build integrity, platform support, or CI reliability
